An OPC UA signal quality issue has been detected on ', if(empty(string(pipeline().parameters.equipment_id)),'unknown equipment',string(pipeline().parameters.equipment_id)), '. Details below.

', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '
', if(equals(string(pipeline().parameters.quality),'BAD'),'HIGH','MEDIUM'), ' - Equipment Signal Alert
Equipment', if(empty(string(pipeline().parameters.equipment_id)),'-',string(pipeline().parameters.equipment_id)), '
Facility', if(empty(string(pipeline().parameters.facility_id)),'-',string(pipeline().parameters.facility_id)), '
Signal quality', string(pipeline().parameters.quality), '
Measured value', if(empty(string(pipeline().parameters.value)),'-',string(pipeline().parameters.value)), ' ', if(empty(string(pipeline().parameters.unit)),'',string(pipeline().parameters.unit)), '
Timestamp (UTC)', if(empty(string(pipeline().parameters.event_time)),'-',formatDateTime(string(pipeline().parameters.event_time),'dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss')), '
Severity', if(equals(string(pipeline().parameters.quality),'BAD'),'HIGH','MEDIUM'), '
Alert type', if(equals(string(pipeline().parameters.quality),'BAD'),'SingleFailure','SignalDegradation'), '
